basis: actual routed hd_turn_a candidate35 pinreg pad groups; fixed measured input slew and measured total output net cap; cell-only NLDM sensitivity, NOT proof of new-clock insertion
limitations: Changing buffer input capacitance changes upstream loading/slew; full net insertion is not equal to the cell propagation number.
Existing routed wire geometry is held fixed for sensitivity. No new graph was placed, routed, or adopted.
Any out-of-table evaluation is explicitly flagged, is extrapolation, and cannot qualify a conservative cell choice.
A COMPLETED reference canary is not silicon physical closure; this study supplies clock-design sizing only.
